source.treeDefinition: Tree cover class includes areas dominated by trees with cover of 10% or more, including planted trees, plantations and olive trees. It is not a FAO forest, forestry production, timber availability or tree-volume classification.
source.sourceCoverage: Sentinel-2-observed land except Antarctica; northern limit 82.75°N. Current Europe frame is 32–73°N and includes western Russia.
source.attribution: © ESA WorldCover project 2021 / Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data (2021) processed by ESA WorldCover consortium

method: Read 64 KiB TIFF prefixes and only the lowest internal categorical overview DEFLATE block. No complete 10 m tile downloaded. Range hashes identify the actual source bytes used, not the SHA256 of full original tiles.
